# smartbanner-tsx

**Smart App Banner for React 18/19** — a lightweight, zero-dependency component that promotes your iOS and Android apps on mobile websites. SSR-safe, typed, and easy to make your own with CSS variables or a headless hook.

> 🎯 Live playground: [smartbanner-tsx.js.org](https://smartbanner-tsx.js.org)
> 🙏 Inspired by [react-smartbanner](https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-smartbanner)

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/smartbanner-tsx.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/smartbanner-tsx) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/smartbanner-tsx.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/smartbanner-tsx) [![size](https://deno.bundlejs.com/?q=smartbanner-tsx&config=%7B%22esbuild%22%3A%7B%22external%22%3A%5B%22react%22%2C%22react-dom%22%2C%22react%2Fjsx-runtime%22%5D%7D%7D&badge)](https://bundlejs.com/?q=smartbanner-tsx&config=%7B%22esbuild%22%3A%7B%22external%22%3A%5B%22react%22%2C%22react-dom%22%2C%22react%2Fjsx-runtime%22%5D%7D%7D)

## Features

- 🪶 **~2.5 KB gzipped, zero runtime dependencies** — only React as a peer
- 📱 **Smart detection** — shows on Android and on iOS browsers without Apple's native banner (Chrome, Firefox, in-app browsers); hidden in installed PWAs
- 🍪 **Remembers the user's choice** — stays hidden for N days after close or install
- 🎨 **Easy to theme** — CSS variables, class names, or your own markup via `useSmartBanner()`
- ⚡ **SSR & Next.js App Router ready** — hydration-safe, ships with `"use client"`
- ✅ **TypeScript first** — typed props, translations and hook

## Installation

```bash
npm install smartbanner-tsx
# or
pnpm add smartbanner-tsx
# or
yarn add smartbanner-tsx
```

## Usage

1. Add your app IDs and icon to `<head>` (the same tags Apple's native banner uses):

```html
<head>
  <meta name="apple-itunes-app" content="app-id=544007664" />
  <meta name="google-play-app" content="app-id=com.google.android.youtube" />
  <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/icon.png" />
</head>
```

2. Render the banner:

```tsx
import { SmartBanner } from "smartbanner-tsx";
import "smartbanner-tsx/style.css";

export default function App() {
  return <SmartBanner title="YouTube" author="Google LLC" />;
}
```

No meta tags? Pass the IDs and icon as props instead (props win when both are set):

```tsx
<SmartBanner
  title="YouTube"
  appId={{ ios: "544007664", android: "com.google.android.youtube" }}
  icon="/icon.png"
/>
```

### Next.js (App Router)

The package ships with `"use client"`, so you can render it straight from `app/layout.tsx`, inside `<body>`:

```tsx
<body>
  <SmartBanner title="YouTube" appId={{ ios: "544007664", android: "com.google.android.youtube" }} />
  {children}
</body>
```

## Upgrading from v1

v2 keeps the v1 props, meta tags, class names and markup. The visible change is the new default look. To keep the v1 look, import the classic styles:

```diff
- import "smartbanner-tsx/dist/style.css";
+ import "smartbanner-tsx/classic.css";
```

See [MIGRATION.md](./MIGRATION.md) for the full list of changes.

## Customization

### 1. Props and translations

```tsx
<SmartBanner
  title="YouTube"
  placement="bottom"
  className="my-banner"
  translations={{ button: "Open", price_ios: "GET", close: "Dismiss" }}
  onInstall={(platform) => analytics.track("app_banner_install", { platform })}
/>
```

### 2. CSS variables

Override them globally, per platform (`.smartbanner-ios`, `.smartbanner-android`), or through the `style` prop.

```css
:root {
  --smartbanner-button-bg: #ff0033;
  --smartbanner-button-radius: 8px;
}

.smartbanner-android {
  --smartbanner-bg: #121212;
  --smartbanner-title-color: #fff;
}
```

See [all variables](https://smartbanner-tsx.js.org/#css-variables), or let the [playground](https://smartbanner-tsx.js.org/#playground) generate them for you.

### 3. Headless hook

Use the logic and render your own markup ([all fields](https://smartbanner-tsx.js.org/#hook-result)):

```tsx
const banner = useSmartBanner({ appId: { ios: "544007664", android: "com.google.android.youtube" } });

if (!banner.visible) return null;

return (
  <div className="my-banner">
    <a href={banner.link} onClick={banner.install}>{banner.t.button}</a>
    <button onClick={banner.close}>{banner.t.close}</button>
  </div>
);
```

### 4. shadcn/ui

Using [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com)? Add a Tailwind version of the banner that uses your theme tokens and `Button`:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://smartbanner-tsx.js.org/r/smart-banner.json
```

It adds `components/smart-banner.tsx` on top of `useSmartBanner()`: you own the markup, detection and cookies stay in the package. [More on the site](https://smartbanner-tsx.js.org/#shadcn).

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | | App title |
| `author` | `string` | | App author or publisher |
| `translations` | `Partial<Translations>` | English texts | `button`, `price_ios`, `price_android`, `store_ios`, `store_android`, `close` |
| `icon` | `string` | from `<link rel="apple-touch-icon">` | App icon URL |
| `appId` | `{ ios?, android? }` | from meta tags | App IDs |
| `meta` | `{ ios?, android? }` | `apple-itunes-app` / `google-play-app` | Meta tag names to read the app ID from |
| `url` | `{ ios?, android? }` | generated | Custom store links |
| `storeLang` | `string` | region of `navigator.language` or `us` | Country in the App Store link |
| `force` | `'ios' \| 'android'` | | Always show for this platform (testing) |
| `ignoreIosVersion` | `boolean` | `false` | Show in iOS Safari too |
| `daysHidden` | `number` | `15` | Days hidden after close |
| `daysReminder` | `number` | `90` | Days hidden after the button click |
| `placement` | `'top' \| 'bottom'` | `'top'` | Position |
| `disableHtmlMargin` | `boolean` | `false` | Don't add a margin to `<html>` |
| `withPortal` | `boolean` | `true` | Render in a React portal |
| `portalTargetId` | `string` | `document.body` | Portal target element ID |
| `className` / `style` | | | Extra class / inline styles for the root |
| `target` | `string` | `'_blank'` | Target of the store link |
| `onShow` / `onClose` / `onInstall` | `(platform) => void` | | Callbacks |

Also exported: `resetSmartBanner()` (clears the "closed"/"installed" cookies), `detectDevice()` and `resolvePlatform()`.

## FAQ

**Why don't I see the banner on my iPhone in Safari?**
Safari on iOS shows Apple's native Smart App Banner from the `apple-itunes-app` meta tag, so this banner is skipped there to avoid two banners. It shows in Chrome, Firefox and in-app browsers on iOS, and on Android. Set `ignoreIosVersion` to show it in Safari too.

**Why doesn't it show on desktop?**
It only targets phones and tablets. Use `force="ios"` or `force="android"` to preview it.

**I closed the banner and it doesn't come back.**
Closing sets the `smartbanner-closed` cookie for `daysHidden` days, tapping the button sets `smartbanner-installed` for `daysReminder` days. Call `resetSmartBanner()` or delete the cookies.

More in the [FAQ on the site](https://smartbanner-tsx.js.org/#faq). Docs for AI tools: [llms.txt](https://smartbanner-tsx.js.org/llms.txt), [llms-full.txt](https://smartbanner-tsx.js.org/llms-full.txt).

# Reference

## CSS variables

| Variable | What it changes |
| --- | --- |
| `--smartbanner-bg` | Background |
| `--smartbanner-title-color` | Title color |
| `--smartbanner-text-color` | Author and price color |
| `--smartbanner-button-bg` | Button background |
| `--smartbanner-button-color` | Button text color |
| `--smartbanner-button-radius` | Button corner radius |
| `--smartbanner-close-color` | Close icon color |
| `--smartbanner-icon-size` | Icon size (56px) |
| `--smartbanner-icon-radius` | Icon corner radius |
| `--smartbanner-height` | Banner height and page offset (80px) |
| `--smartbanner-font` | Font family |
| `--smartbanner-border` | Border between banner and page |
| `--smartbanner-shadow` | Box shadow |
| `--smartbanner-z-index` | Stacking order (9998) |
| `--smartbanner-max-width` | Max width of the content |

## useSmartBanner() result

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `visible` | `boolean` | Whether the banner should be shown now. |
| `platform` | `'ios' \| 'android' \| undefined` | Detected or forced platform. |
| `appId` | `string` | App ID for the platform. |
| `link` | `string` | Store link. |
| `icon` | `string` | Icon URL. |
| `description` | `string` | Price and store text, e.g. “Free - On the App Store”. |
| `t` | `Translations` | Texts merged with the defaults. |
| `close` | `() => void` | Hides the banner for daysHidden days. |
| `install` | `() => void` | Hides the banner for daysReminder days. |

## FAQ

**Why don't I see the banner on my iPhone in Safari?**
Safari on iOS shows Apple's native Smart App Banner from the apple-itunes-app meta tag, so this banner is skipped there to avoid two banners. It shows in Chrome, Firefox and in-app browsers on iOS, and on Android. Set ignoreIosVersion to show it in Safari too.

**Why doesn't the banner show on desktop?**
It only targets phones and tablets. Use the force prop (force="ios" or force="android") to preview it on desktop.

**I closed the banner and it doesn't come back. How do I test it again?**
Closing sets the smartbanner-closed cookie for daysHidden days, and tapping the button sets smartbanner-installed for daysReminder days. Call resetSmartBanner() or delete these cookies.

**Does it work with Next.js, Remix or other SSR frameworks?**
Yes. Nothing is rendered on the server, everything is read after mount, and the package ships with "use client", so you can render it from a Next.js App Router layout.

**Can I use my own design?**
Yes. Restyle the default banner with CSS variables and class names, use the useSmartBanner() hook and render your own markup, or add the shadcn/ui component for a Tailwind version you can edit.

**How is it different from react-smartbanner?**
smartbanner-tsx is written in TypeScript, has no runtime dependencies, supports React 18 and 19, is SSR-safe and offers CSS variables and a headless hook.

---

# Migrating from v1 to v2

v2 keeps the same component, props, meta tags, class names and markup. For most apps the upgrade is:

```bash
npm install smartbanner-tsx@2
```

The one visible change is the **new default look**. If you want the banner to look exactly like in v1, change one import:

```diff
- import "smartbanner-tsx/dist/style.css";
+ import "smartbanner-tsx/classic.css";
```

That's it. Everything below is a detailed list, so you can check whether anything applies to you.

## Checklist

| | Change | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ⚠️ | New default styles | Nothing, or use `classic.css` for the v1 look |
| ⚠️ | `ua-parser-js` and `js-cookie` are no longer dependencies | Install them yourself if your own code imports them |
| ⚠️ | `<html>` classes are set only while the banner is visible | Only matters if your CSS targets `.smartbanner-margin-top` / `-bottom` without `.smartbanner-show` |
| ℹ️ | Build target is ES2018 (was ES2015) | Nothing for browsers from 2018+ (iOS 12+, Android Chrome 64+) |
| ℹ️ | App Store links use `apps.apple.com`, Play links use `https` | Nothing |
| ✅ | Meta tags, props, class names, markup, cookie names | Unchanged |

## Breaking changes

### 1. New default styles

`style.css` was rewritten: a modern iOS/Android look, flexbox layout and [CSS variables](./README.md#2-css-variables) for theming. The HTML structure and class names did not change.

- **You use the default styles and like the new look** — nothing to do.
- **You want the v1 look** — import `smartbanner-tsx/classic.css` instead of `style.css`. It is the v1 stylesheet, unchanged.
- **You override the default styles with your own CSS** — colors and fonts usually keep working. Overrides of layout (`line-height`, `width` of `.smartbanner-info`, `inline-block` alignment) may need a look, because v2 uses flexbox. If you don't want to touch them, use `classic.css`. Or replace overrides with variables:

```css
/* v1 */
.smartbanner-ios .smartbanner-button { color: #ff0033; }

/* v2 */
:root { --smartbanner-button-bg: #ff0033; }
```

### 2. No runtime dependencies

v2 has its own small user agent and cookie helpers, so `ua-parser-js` (AGPL-3.0 licensed since v2) and `js-cookie` are not installed anymore. If your app imports them directly and relied on them being installed through `smartbanner-tsx`, add them to your `package.json`.

### 3. `<html>` classes

v1 always added `smartbanner-margin-top` (or `-bottom`) to `<html>`, and `smartbanner-show` while the banner was visible. v2 adds all of them only while the banner is visible and removes them when it is closed or unmounted. This fixes a stuck 80px page margin after unmounting the banner. Selectors like `.smartbanner-show.smartbanner-margin-top`, which the default CSS uses, work as before.

## Behavior that stays the same

- The app ID is read from `<meta name="apple-itunes-app">` / `<meta name="google-play-app">` (or your `meta` names). Without an app ID the banner is not shown.
- The icon is read from `<link rel="apple-touch-icon">` / `android-touch-icon`.
- Cookie names are still `smartbanner-closed` and `smartbanner-installed`, so users who closed the banner in v1 won't see it again until the cookie expires.
- iOS Safari is skipped (it has Apple's native banner) unless `ignoreIosVersion` is set.

## Small fixes you might notice

- iPads in "desktop website" mode are now detected as iOS. In Safari they still get Apple's native banner; in Chrome or Firefox for iPad they now see this banner.
- The store country is read correctly from locales with a script, e.g. `zh-Hant-TW` → `tw` (v1 returned `hant`).
- `javascript:`, `data:` and `vbscript:` links in the `url` prop are replaced with `#`.
- Works in Next.js App Router server components: the package ships with `"use client"`.

## New in v2 (optional)

```tsx
<SmartBanner
  title="YouTube"
  // App IDs without meta tags
  appId={{ ios: "544007664", android: "com.google.android.youtube" }}
  // Icon without link tags
  icon="/icon.png"
  // Inline CSS variables
  style={{ "--smartbanner-button-bg": "#ff0033" }}
  // Localized close button label
  translations={{ close: "Закрыть" }}
  // Callbacks now receive the platform, plus a new onShow
  onShow={(platform) => track("banner_show", platform)}
  onInstall={(platform) => track("banner_install", platform)}
/>
```

- `useSmartBanner()` — the banner logic without markup, for a fully custom design.
- `resetSmartBanner()` — clears the "closed"/"installed" cookies.
- `detectDevice()` / `resolvePlatform()` — the detection used by the banner.
- Exported types: `SmartBannerProps`, `SmartBannerOptions`, `SmartBannerState`, `Platform`, `Translations`.
- Shorter CSS import: `smartbanner-tsx/style.css` (the `dist/style.css` path still works).
